strategy: Long-only swing pullback/breakout setups approved by the independent final decision agent under priced-plan-1.0. Require prior confirmed daily entry conditions; no ADD or averaging down during this pilot. Rank eligible entries by existing scout score descending, then ticker. Stops and first measured target are fixed; no trailing stop or mid-week tuning.
riskSizing: Whole shares limited by 1% current equity planned stop risk, 4% aggregate stop risk, 25% stock allocation, 40% sector allocation, 10% cash reserve and 1% median daily share volume. Include both fixed fees and adverse exit slippage. Stops are scenarios, not guaranteed loss limits.
fillModel: All-or-none simulated entry at the open of the first eligible completed one-minute TradingView candle strictly after decision completion, plus 0.1% adverse slippage, only within the approved entry zone and at <=1% candle volume. Try at most five eligible minutes in the same session; gaps/missing minutes block a fill. Entry price is never an old delayed quote. Unfilled orders incur no fee. Filled orders incur exactly EGP 5 each; slippage is a separate simulation assumption, not a broker fee.
exitModel: After a paper entry, observe fixed stop/T1 on subsequent one-minute candles. If both are touched, flag ambiguity and prioritize the stop. Precommitted exit triggers at that candle end; simulate a full exit at a later minute open less 0.1% adverse slippage, subject to positive raw volume and the same 1% participation cap. A gap may exceed planned risk. Do not assume execution at the stop or target. If unfilled, retain and flag the open risk.
settlement: Broker-neutral simulation: sale proceeds become available after a simulated sell fill. No T+2 restriction, withdrawal service or broker-specific order rules are assumed.

sources.research: TradingView plus dated issuer, exchange/regulator and other authoritative primary disclosures; missing evidence blocks approval
sources.notion: Not required; local experiment SQLite is authoritative

weekEnd: No forced Thursday liquidation. Report open holdings separately, with unrealized P&L. Preserve 5/20/60-session observation follow-up in the existing nightly workflow. No new paper entries after 15 October.
amendments: Append proposals only. Data-integrity failures suspend affected simulated execution; never rewrite past decisions or silently apply changed rules.
initialStatus: Prepared; first open-session freshness test, calendar/corporate-action evidence and experiment preflight remain required. No real-account capital or risk limits are set.

targets.checkpointCompletion: 100% of scheduled trading-day checkpoints; independently document holidays
targets.riskCompliance: 100% of proposed entries within frozen limits
targets.evidenceCompleteness: 100% of fills traceable to timestamped TradingView bars and an approved plan
targets.feeReconciliation: Exactly EGP 5 per filled order; zero for unfilled orders
targets.profitability: Measure net return and matched index excess return; no forced profit target or minimum trade count

evaluation.report: Daily scorecard and immutable JSON/Markdown evidence reports. At Thursday 22:00 produce intensive sourced narrative with trade attribution, rejected-candidate review, failure analysis and prioritized testable improvements. No automatic parameter tuning.
